verdict.rationale: Orama Cloud's docs say users can delete data within segregated data sources. That is a direct but thin deletion capability. The pack has no documented retention policies, TTLs, purge guarantees, or retention controls for AI/answer-session data. Missing for 10: configurable retention periods or TTLs, documented deletion guarantees and purge semantics, controls over retention of query and AI-session data, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: Every data source is segregated from the others, so you can update, delete, or add new data without affecting the data in the other data sources.
